name: FRED API (Federal Reserve Economic Data)
rate_limits: 120 requests/minute. Free API key required (instant registration).
notes: Gold standard for US economic data. 840,000+ time series from 118 sources including Federal Reserve, BLS, Census Bureau, and more. Completely free with API key. Supports JSON and XML. 31 endpoints covering categories, releases, series, sources, and tags. Python wrapper available (fredapi). Essential for any AI system doing macro-economic analysis. Key endpoints: fred/series/observations, fred/series/search, fred/category, fred/releases. Example: https://api.stlouisfed.org/fred/series/observations?series_id=GNPCA&api_key=KEY&file_type=json
